text:
jamie (devex): Quick async — planning SDK v1.5 rollout this Wed. Need owners for lane assignments (canary/stable), changelog cutover, sample app update, and merge-window approvals. Proposed merge window: Wed 14:00-15:00 UTC. Who's owning what?

marcus (sdk): I can own merge approvals and the stable lane. Will need a PR list by Tue EOD. :+1:

lee (docs): I’ll take docs and the changelog cutover. Can we set changelog cutoff to Wed 13:00 UTC so I have an hour to finalize? :eyes:

olga (samples): I can do the sample apps, but FYI the new client auth change requires a tiny API tweak. ETA Tue EOD for sample app update, barring regressions.

jamie (devex): Sounds good. Notes: branch naming = release/v1.5-sdk, canary lane branch = canary/v1.5. I'll open a meta PR that lists all release PRs.

katie (qa): QA needs a staging build by Wed 09:00 UTC. Can CI produce a staged artifact from release/v1.5-sdk by then? Also will run smoke + compat matrix.

ci-bot: nightly-build: failed on unit-tests in sdk-core (flaky/test-timeouts). https://ci.internal/build/4221

marcus (sdk): I'll triage the failing tests today. If flaky, we'll mark flaky and re-kick. Otherwise I can hotfix before Tue EOD.

olga (samples): small note — sample app uses embed API which changed param name from `model_id` -> `model`. I’ll add a compatibility shim in samples to avoid breaking docs.

lee (docs): Thanks @olga — if you add the shim, I’ll keep examples consistent with the new param and note the shim in the migration section.

jamie (devex): Ownership recap: canary lane = jamie (do deploy runbook + monitor), stable lane = marcus (merge approvals), docs/changelog = lee, samples = olga, QA gate = katie. I'll send calendar invites for Wed 13:30 UTC pre-merge check and 14:00 UTC merge window.

marcus (sdk): For merge approvals — pls post PR list here. I’ll only approve PRs that have green CI and 1 LGTM from core reviewers.

jamie (devex): PR list draft: #1245 sdk-core logging, #1248 sample-auth-compat (olga), #1251 docs-links (lee), #1256 batching-ops (marcus). Will update with links.

katie (qa): Confirmed — will run smoke on those PR artifacts once CI passes. If any blocking regressions, I’ll ping SRE and block merge.

jamie (devex): Quick rollback plan: if post-merge errors > 5% error-rate on canary within 20m, we'll revert to previous image and open an incident. @sre-bot will post metrics.

sre-bot: Alert rule configured: /canary/sdk/v1.5 error_rate > 5% for 5m -> pager to #eng-oncall.

marcus (sdk): One ask — can we lift the staging artifact TTL to 48h so QA can re-run long tests without re-building? CI team? @ci-bot

ci-bot: Artifact retention extended to 48h for release/v1.5-sdk builds (requested by marcus).

olga (samples): ETA reminders: sample PR ready Tue 18:00 UTC, will request review then.

lee (docs): I’ll cut changelog at Wed 13:00 UTC as agreed. Please avoid last-minute small text tweaks after cutoff — they’ll go into post-release patch.

jamie (devex): Thanks all. If no major objections, I'll lock the merge window and post the final PR list by Tue 20:00 UTC. :rocket:
